name: grill-me
title: Grill Me
description: Relentlessly question the user until the design concept is shared and decision complete.
command_description: Interrogate the task until the design concept is explicit and implementation-safe.
prompt: Interview the user aggressively about goals, constraints, interfaces, failure modes, rollout, and tradeoffs until the design concept is shared. Resolve questions in dependency order. Externalize the result to docs/ai/design_concept.md instead of leaving it only in chat history.
